" alt="Fig.2原图裁剪：夹爪鱼眼相机、基座后部iPhone与机载电源/计算的位置。"></div><figcaption>Fig. 2 · PDF p.2 · 正式版原图裁剪（未更改图内数据；勾选上方可查看原尺寸）。Fig.2原图裁剪：夹爪鱼眼相机、基座后部iPhone与机载电源/计算的位置。 图源：Huy Ha、Yihuai Gao、Zipeng Fu、Jie Tan、Shuran Song，UMI-on-Legs，CoRL 2024 / PMLR 270 (2025)。© 原作者；此处用于对应方法的学术评述。<a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=2">原文与完整图注</a></figcaption></figure><div id="code-wbc_node-1089"><p class="source">[代码] get_tcp_pose：通过固定外参与臂正运动学得到里程计世界中的TCP位姿 · <a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/real-wbc/modules/wbc_node.py#L1089-L1097">real-wbc/modules/wbc_node.py:1089–1097</a> · d75c9c182d80</p><pre><code>    def get_tcp_pose(self, arm_dof_pos: np.ndarray) -&gt; np.ndarray:
        &quot;&quot;&quot;
        In the iphone pose frame
        &quot;&quot;&quot;
        arx5_ee_pose = self.arx5_solver.forward_kinematics(arm_dof_pos)
        ee2arm = affines.compose(
            T=arx5_ee_pose[:3], R=euler.euler2mat(*arx5_ee_pose[3:]), Z=np.ones(3)
        )
        return self.robot_pose @ self.arm2base @ ee2arm @ self.tcp2ee</code></pre></div><p><span class="tag">代码</span>矩阵链robot_pose @ arm2base @ ee2arm @ tcp2ee将基座世界姿态、臂安装外参、机械臂FK和TCP偏移串起来。本文读取了调用链；ARX5 SDK的forward_kinematics内部及真实标定数值准确性未逐行/实测核验，不能仅凭函数调用声称姿态已校准。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/real-wbc/modules/wbc_node.py#L1089-L1097">real-wbc/modules/wbc_node.py:1089–1097</a></p><p><span class="tag">代码</span>iPhone Python侧解码4×4矩阵与时间戳（Swift列优先矩阵转置），维护接收时间与位姿，结合base2iphone得到基座位姿；可选速度积分路径存在。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/real-wbc/modules/pose_estimator.py#L40-L57">real-wbc/modules/pose_estimator.py:40–57</a>；<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/real-wbc/modules/pose_estimator.py#L324-L367">real-wbc/modules/pose_estimator.py:324–367</a></p><p><span class="tag">论文</span>iPhone VIO约140 ms延迟，动捕约8 ms；作者尝试速度前推但没有显著改善，不能因为代码有积分器就声称延迟问题已解决。论文还说明真实控制链约20 ms仿真延迟匹配重要，URDF质量/惯量重测与安全微调不可忽略。<span class="source">§7.4、§8.2–8.4 · PDF页 <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=13">13</a>、<a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=14">14</a></span></p><p><span class="tag">代码</span>实时lowlevel_state_cb构造世界目标，转到TCP系；策略开始后，位置误差有>0.5 m触发停止及>0.1 m裁剪分支。这是该版本的保护处理，不是对任何真机部署都充分的安全保证。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/real-wbc/modules/wbc_node.py#L654-L665">real-wbc/modules/wbc_node.py:654–665</a></p><p><span class="tag">未核验</span>主仓库固定了ARX5 SDK子模块9cf19e04c5ebf6cd094249b81190da6a55901828和iPhoneVIO子模块adabceaf02f0485a64c0f739f04c1d945b3802a4。此处确认gitlink与URL，不声称已审阅全部子模块、下载设备固件或验证ROS2实时性。</p></section><section id="chains"><div class="eyebrow">STAGE 03</div><h2>训练与推理：把两条全链路分开</h2><h3>训练：已读到的WBC调用链</h3><ol><li><span class="tag">代码</span>scripts/train.py用Hydra加载train.yaml，解析配置并构建IsaacGymEnv及OnPolicyRunner；有ckpt_path时加载检查点继续训练。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/scripts/train.py#L12-L26">mani-centric-wbc/scripts/train.py:12–26</a></li><li><span class="tag">代码</span>defaults链为train→combo_go2ARX5_pickle_reaching_extreme→pickle_reaching→reaching→env_go2ARX5→env_base；sequence_sampler替换为PicklePoseSequenceLoader。当前配置的实际任务是reaching，不是看到目录里locomotion文件就认为先训练移动策略再拼接。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/config/train.yaml#L1-L6">mani-centric-wbc/config/train.yaml:1–6</a>；<a class="tag">代码</span>环境reset抽轨迹，observe构造机器人/目标观测；actor高斯采样动作，环境模拟、返回reward/done；runner累积on-policy rollout，再计算returns并调用PPO update。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/rsl_rl/runners/on_policy_runner.py#L175-L266">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/rsl_rl/runners/on_policy_runner.py:175–266</a>；<a class="tag">代码</span>PPO损失包括裁剪概率比的surrogate、值函数误差和熵项；训练配置最终覆盖gamma为0.99、entropy_coef为0.01，而子配置原始值分别0.9与0.001。只读ppo.yaml会读错最终训练参数。<a href="https://github.com/real-stanford/umi-on-legs/blob/d75c9c182d8044dadf53043612da2ffbf1936a97/mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/rsl_rl/algorithms/ppo.py#L209-L240">mani-centric-wbc/legged_gym/rsl_rl/algorithms/ppo.py:209–240</a>；<a class="tag">论文</span>论文实验报告所有比较训练4000轮、Unified另微调1000；仓库train.yaml默认reaching可训练20000轮。默认最大轮数不是论文实际选用检查点轮数。<span class="source">§10.2 · PDF页 <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v270/main/assets/ha25a/ha25a.pdf#page=16">16</a>、<a class="tag">代码</span>evaluate.py加载eval.yaml并要求ckpt_path。eval.yaml使用250个环境×每环境2个episode的目标计数；文档命令覆盖episode_length_s=17与8点preview。runner.eval暂时关闭push/transport扰动，再执行确定性推理、收集统计并恢复标志。文件载入路径存在不等于本页验证了相应checkpoint或重新得到500条结果。<a class="tag">论文 / 未核验实现</span>上层图像→扩散轨迹→使用图像时刻相机位姿转到世界；完整UMI-on-Legs发布端未定位。</li><li><span class="tag">代码</span>ROS2 EEFTraj回调→RealtimeTraj.update；机器人LowState回调+机械臂状态→TCP世界位姿→按相对时间采样轨迹→局部位置/6D旋转→与上一动作拼接。</li><li><span class="tag">代码</span>policy_timer_callback读取观测history并调用actor→动作缩放偏置→腿关节重排→腿和臂命令。基座/iPhone/臂状态按不同回调异步更新，本文未测时序。</li><li><span class="tag">差异</span>当前部署文件把preview偏移归零，自适应延迟匹配没有应用时间轴平移，故上面是源码实际链路，不能不加限定地称为论文全部设计原样实现。</li></ol></section><section id="conditions"><div class="eyebrow">STAGE 03</div><h2>实现条件、差异与未核验项</h2><div
